P-OPUS-01.summary: A private, all-in-one browser for IT7Q clients, with mail, chat, passwords and support built in. Available on desktop and as a signed Android app.

sections.heading: In the current release
items: Desktop app plus a signed Android build
IT7Q login built in
A download page for clients

sections.heading: Next release adds
items: Hermes Mail and Nexus messaging
A built-in password manager and bookmark manager
The IT7Q Support Portal
Andromeda AI with a choice of AI providers
On-demand malware scanning and network-level ad and tracker blocking
A one-click private connection back to IT7Q services

P-OPUS-02.summary: A clean, fast email app that handles several accounts at once and has an IT7Q support channel in its sidebar.

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: Web version running
Works with several mailboxes at once

sections.heading: What's next
items: Fix a display bug on some messages
A Windows installer
An Android app

P-OPUS-03.summary: Two sister tools: Calendis, a multi-user calendar anyone can sign up for, and Calendi IT7Q, the internal planner that keeps IT7Q's projects on track.

sections.heading: Calendi IT7Q
items: Syncs with Google Calendar
Colour-coded per project
Orders work by simplicity and urgency
Per-project timelines, start and finish dates, and daily goals

sections.heading: History
items: Grew out of a single-club calendar first built for Pine Rivers RSL, since retired

P-OPUS-04.summary: A screener for dyslexia and visual stress that runs entirely offline, keeps results on the device and shows them instantly.

sections.heading: Features
items: Seven screening modules
Results as an at-a-glance radar chart
PDF export for parents, teachers or clinicians
History, with side-by-side comparison of sessions

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: Second milestone complete

P-OPUS-05.summary: IT7Q's secure, self-hosted messaging system. It already carries the alerts and reports from IT7Q's AI agents, each in its own channel.

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: Messaging server live with 21 agent channels
A cross-platform messenger app started
A Linux desktop package planned

P-OPUS-06.summary: A purpose-built desktop operating system: a minimal, locked-down Linux base with the Athena Browser as the whole desktop.

sections.heading: Progress
items: First three milestones complete
Now integrating IT7Q's own apps (Athena, Nexus) as proper packages
Updates will come from IT7Q's own signed software source

P-OPUS-07.summary: A safe, guided computer for kids, built as a locked-down kiosk with a friendly AI companion.

sections.heading: Features
items: CUSTOS, an owl companion powered by an AI model and tuned for children
A daily journal with welfare monitoring that can alert parents
Nexus Kids Chat: friends are added only when both sets of parents approve

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: First release complete

P-OPUS-08.summary: A unified messaging gateway: messages from chat and social apps land in one inbox inside Nexus.

sections.heading: Design
items: Each platform connected with its own secure sign-in
A unified inbox tab in Nexus
Will use MNEMOSYNE so replies keep context

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: In design

P-OPUS-09.summary: A private alternative to Google Workspace that brings every OPUS app together into one suite.

sections.heading: Brings together
items: Hermes Mail
Calendis
Nexus messaging
Files and documents

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: In design

P-OPUS-10.summary: An AI companion app that works with more than one AI provider, so people can pick the one that suits them.

sections.heading: Features
items: One app, several AI providers
Conversations kept in one place

Explains each step as it goes
